description: Audit a Solana SPL token mint for rug-pull and honeypot risks. Pass base58 `mint` address (required) and optional `force_refresh` boolean. Returns `risk_score` (0-100), `risk_band` (`low`, `medium`, `high`, `critical`), `safe_to_trade`, mint/freeze authority flags, top-10 holder concentration, and Raydium/PumpSwap liquidity and 24h buy/sell counts. Do not use for EVM tokens (use check_evm_token_risk) or wallet portfolios (use get_solana_wallet_holdings). 1 free try per IP, then HTTP 402 ($0.002 USDC).

session_token.description: Optional prepaid x402s_... session token from open_agent_session or https://apix402data.com/pay used after the 1 free try rolls over to HTTP 402.
